items.html: It has already been explained above that the seven lights of the Kings of BON rose, were included, and clothed in the three lines of Hochma, Bina, and Keter, which expanded to the end of the aforementioned place, which is HGT. And now the aforementioned expansion returned to be gathered above, and returned to be as it was at first, so that only GR remained in their place above, and it raised together with them, in their place above, the seven lower lights, and now all seven lower lights are found above, in the place of Bina. For she is the mother of the children, and there is the place where pregnancy and Ibur take place.
